---
title: Inline-code highlighting
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Inline code with `{.python}` is highlighted the same way as
        # fenced code blocks: outer <code class="sourceCode python">
        # plus nested hl-* spans.
        - ["<code class=\"sourceCode python\"", "hl-function-builtin\">print</span>"]
---

Inline code spans can opt into highlighting by attaching a language
class. The syntax is `` `expr`{.lang} `` — the `{.lang}` attribute
tells Quarto which grammar to apply.

For example, the Python builtin `print()`{.python} renders with the
same `hl-function-builtin` color as it would inside a fenced code
block. An unclassed inline span like `print()` stays plain.

This is useful for API reference prose where you're naming functions,
keywords, or types: write `` `Map.entrySet()`{.java} `` or
`` `Vec::new()`{.rust} `` and they'll be styled to match surrounding
code blocks.
